mapper.select: SELECT id,name,phone,unit_name,password_hash FROM app_user WHERE phone=#{phone} AND status='ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user WHERE id=#{accountId} AND status='ACTIVE'

SELECT e.id,e.name,e.phone,e.email,e.created_by,u.unit_name,d.name department_name FROM organization_employee e JOIN app_user u ON u.id=e.created_by AND u.status='ACTIVE' JOIN organization_department d ON d.id=e.department_id WHERE e.id=#{employeeId} AND e.status='ACTIVE'
